question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eligible"** means having the right to do or obtain something; satisfying the appropriate conditions. (योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** She is eligible to apply for the scholarship.
 
 
 
• The word **"Poignant"** means evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret. (मार्मिक)
 
 
• **Example:** The movie had a poignant ending that left everyone in tears.
 
 
 
• The word **"Gourrmet"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Gourmet"**, which means a person who enjoys and knows a lot about good food and drink. (भोजन-विशेषज्ञ)
 
 
• **Example:** He is a gourmet who loves trying out different cuisines.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eligible** (योग्य): Having the right to do or obtain something; satisfying the appropriate conditions.
 
 
• **Example:** She is eligible to apply for the scholarship.
 
 
 
• **Poignant** (मार्मिक): Evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie had a poignant ending that left everyone in tears.
 
 
 
• **Relevant** (प्रासंगिक): Closely connected or appropriate to what is being done or considered.
 
 
• **Example:** His comments were relevant to the discussion we were having.
